name: PRSM
author: ZeroSR
description: Do 2 quick clicks before the blue portal at 15%, then another click just before the spike to go underneath the cube portal and skip it. Do 2 quick clicks before the red orb at 16%, followed by 2 more quick clicks, and take the X1 speed portal at 18%. Navigate through the gameplay as shown in the video until 38%. Click the spider orb late and do 2–3 clicks underneath the cube portal to enter the blue pads, then click the next 3 blue orbs. Do 3 more clicks right after the blue pads and start spamming at 46% to stay mini. Maintain a consistent position between 48% and 49% between the invisible hitboxes, and stay above the level until the  end.
